page_title: Tokenized Money Market Funds — Digital Assets Dashboard
page_subtitle_html: Tokenized money market fund (MMF) exposure aggregated from RWA.xyz US Treasuries and Non-U.S. Government Debt. Networks and platforms are built from each fund's on-chain token deployments; Distributed Value columns are current levels.
kpi_window_note: Distributed value uses a 30-day (30D) % change vs summed token values 30 days ago. Top network share is the largest network by distributed value; the 30D figure is the change in market-share percentage points (pp), not a percent of total. Fund universe: fixed curated TMMF population on RWA.xyz US Treasuries and Non-U.S. Government Debt; KPIs, charts, and league tables use the same fund set.
key_observations_html:
Key observations

  • TMMF distributed value fell 7.6% over 30D: With distributed value at $13.74B (7.6% lower over 30D), tokenized-cash balances look lighter—suggesting some institutions pulled liquidity or rotated away from TMMF wrappers even if headline product news stayed busy. Related: WisdomTree Opens Tokenized Treasury Fund To MoonPay's 35 Million Accounts (The Defiant).
  • A global regulatory arbitrage map is emerging: distributed value clusters into distinct compliance regimes—U.S. Reg D ~35% of population AUM (e.g. BUIDL, iBENJI); U.S. Reg S ~34% of population AUM (e.g. USYC, USDY); U.S. mutual fund (N-1A) ~9% of population AUM (e.g. WTGXX, FILQ-A). Issuers appear to anchor products in familiar safe harbors rather than one global standard. Related: European stablecoin issuer Qivalis sees transformation of global trade finance (CoinDesk).
  • Issuer models are splitting the TMMF market: The market is still bifurcating: institutional settlement wrappers concentrate AUM in few holders, while retail-leaning yield products stay more holder-dispersed.
  • Rates still matter as much as product and chain choice: Rate and money-market moves can reshape fund-level inflows as quickly as any chain or product launch story. Related: Solana Foundation hires ex-Binance CMO and payments exec as new partnerships expand (CoinTelegraph).
  • Early "flight to efficiency" shows up in TMMF 30D network share: Among tokenized money market funds, gainers include Solana (+1.48% 30D TMMF network share), Stellar (+0.34% 30D TMMF network share); losers include Ethereum (-1.65% 30D TMMF network share), Avalanche C-Chain (-0.23% 30D TMMF network share). That pattern is consistent with TMMF issuers routing more distributed value toward higher-throughput, lower-fee chains—though Ethereum still dominates TMMF share levels in most snapshots.

Context only—not investment advice. Observations rank fund-level and network aggregates on this page against recent tokenization and money-market headlines. Bullets combine on-page data with recent industry headlines.

Key observations are AI generated and should be reviewed for accuracy.
